claim: Cortex-M portfolio spans M0/M0+/M23/M3/M4/M33/M35P/M55/M7; M33/M35P/M55 offer TrustZone and up to 16 MPU regions; M4/M7 add DSP and single/double-precision FPU
MISRA C:2025 (March 2025) is the latest guideline, incremental over MISRA C:2023 which consolidated MISRA C:2012 plus amendments; Addendum 3 (Jan 2025) maps CERT C coverage

standard.clause: Guidelines for the use of the C language in critical systems

claim: MISRA C++:2023 targets C++17 and integrates the AUTOSAR C++ guidelines as the single language subset for safety-related C++

standard.clause: Guidelines for the use of C++17 in critical systems

claim: CMake 3.20.0 is an established minimum baseline (LLVM/Clang build requires it); C++20/C++23/C23 compile features supported from this era forward
ISO 26262:2018 (Parts 1-10) is the current functional-safety baseline with ASIL A-D; Edition 3 is in DIS enquiry phase (ISO/DIS 26262-2/-3, 2026) and not yet published
DO-178C/ED-12C (2011) remains the current airborne software baseline with DAL A-E; supplements DO-330 (tools), DO-331 (model-based), DO-332 (OO), DO-333 (formal methods) apply per technique
Yocto Project 6.0 Wrynose (April 2026) is the current LTS until April 2030 with kernel 6.18 LTS and GCC 15.2; Scarthgap 5.0 LTS remains supported until April 2028

FreeRTOS 202604 LTS (April 2026, kernel 11.3.0) is the current LTS with security hardening, expanded MPU support and MQTT v5.0, supported until April 30 2028; Zephyr supports 1000+ boards with LTS releases maintained 2+ years
ROS 2 Kilted Kaiju (May 2025) is the latest stable release; Jazzy and Humble remain supported; Lyrical is in development (May 2026); default middleware is DDS with Zenoh as non-DDS option
